wire: Cedar Ridge (fictional) wire policy: domestic wires submitted before 4pm ET post same day. Customers cannot cancel a wire after it is released; they must call the fraud line.
card: Lost or stolen cards: customers can freeze the card instantly in the app. A replacement arrives in 5-7 business days. Suspected fraud always goes to a human.
fees: Overdraft fee is $25 per item, max 3 per day. First overdraft in 12 months can be refunded by a banker on request.
hours: Branches are open 9am-5pm Monday-Friday and 9am-1pm Saturday. Phone support is 8am-8pm ET daily.
address: Address changes need identity verification, so the customer must use the app or visit a branch. Do not change addresses by email.
mortgage: Mortgage questions about rates or payoff amounts go to the Home Lending team. Payoff quotes are issued only by a human.
